import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static final long MINF = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;
    static long totalN;
    static long totalCount;
    static long[] sumFirst = new long[7];
    static List<Long>[] digitsFirst = new ArrayList[7];
    static long counter2 = -1;
    static long result = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            digitsFirst[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static boolean isPrime(long x) {
        if (x < 2) return false;
        for (long i = 2; i * i <= x; i++) {
            if (x % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static long getNextLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        while (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            line = br.readLine();
        }
        return Long.parseLong(line.trim());
    }

    static long computeGCD(long a, long b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : computeGCD(b, a % b);
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        long e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void dfsGenerate(int depth, long current) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        long val = (totalCount - current + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        digitsFirst[depth].add(val);
        sumFirst[depth] += val;
        totalCount++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            dfsGenerate(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static void dfsProcess(int depth, long current, long N, List<Long>[] digitsFirst, long[] sumFirst) {
        if (current > N) return;
        if (current * 1000000 + 999999 <= N && current * 10000000 > N) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long shift = (counter2 + 1 - (current * modPow(10, i, MOD_A)) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                List<Long> arr = digitsFirst[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(arr, MOD_A - shift);
                long sumVal = sumFirst[i];
                long size = arr.size();
                long sumPart = sumVal + shift * size - MOD_A * (size - pos);
                result = (result + sumPart) % MOD_B;
            }
            counter2 += totalCount;
            return;
        }
        counter2++;
        result = (result + ((counter2 - current) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A) % MOD_B;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            if (depth == 0 && d == 0) continue;
            dfsProcess(depth + 1, current * 10 + d, N, digitsFirst, sumFirst);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        totalN = getNextLong(br);
        dfsGenerate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digitsFirst[i]);
        }
        dfsProcess(0, 0, totalN, digitsFirst, sumFirst);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
